brief: Q4 install push for Budgetly, a budgeting app. Goal: app installs. The festive season is when Gen Z overspends and then panics in January; position Budgetly as the calm way to see where the money goes before it's gone.
audience: Gen Z, 18-26, first job or studying with part-time income
brandVoice: Friendly, direct, a little dry. Smart older sibling. Never preachy, never promises financial outcomes.
